# Stay Willas — Luxury Private Pool Villas in Maharashtra

> Stay Willas is a premier luxury holiday rental brand in Maharashtra, specializing in handpicked, fully managed private pool villas in Lonavala and Khopoli. Designed for weekend getaways, family reunions, corporate offsites, and intimate staycations near Mumbai and Pune.

## Core Properties

### 1. The Angle House (Lonavala)
- **Location**: Lonavala, Maharashtra
- **Type**: 4 BHK Luxury Private Pool Villa
- **Capacity**: 12 to 15 Guests
- **Key Features**: Private swimming pool, glassmorphic modern architecture, double-height living spaces, mountain valley views, in-house chef, pet-friendly fenced lawn.
- **URL**: https://www.staywillas.com/villa/the-angle-house

### 2. Canopy Crest (Khopoli)
- **Location**: Khopoli, Maharashtra (Near Imagica)
- **Type**: 3 BHK Mountain Sanctuary Private Pool Villa
- **Capacity**: 10 to 15 Guests
- **Key Features**: Temperature-controlled private pool, gazebo lounge, proximity to Zenith Waterfall & Imagica, customizable gourmet meal packages, 24/7 caretaker.
- **URL**: https://www.staywillas.com/villa/canopy-crest
